name: Termi Protocol
description: A 3D simulation environment that visualizes AI coding agent workflows in real-time. Instead of watching scrolling terminal output, developers can see their AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, etc.) working as robots in an immersive 3D workspace with desks, file locks, and collaboration features. The tool provides multi-agent sync mode, checkpoints for time-travel debugging, on-device memory, and one-tap approval for risky actions.
community_quotes: The watch-it-work idea is strongest when the room has a hard mapping to operational state, not just animation.
Giving CLI agents a literal body in a 3D room is a clever way to make what Claude Code / Codex are actually doing legible instead of scrolling terminal logs.
The local-first angle is the part I'd trust most here. For AI coding agents, visibility is useful only if it helps me make a decision: pause, approve, rewind, or compare what two agents changed.
You can already do this inside the Command Center through the History section. From there, you can review what the agent did, see recent activity, inspect tool calls.
The visualization also runs fully local. Your file activity, command activity, and agent workflow are not sent to a hosted backend for rendering.

name: Sim
description: Open-source visual workspace for building AI agents and workflows. Features a drag-and-drop builder similar to Figma for agent development. Positioned as a potential alternative to LangChain for creating agent workflows visually. Ranked #2 Product of the Day on July 10, 2026.
community_quotes: Super easy and fast drag-and-drop builder
Open-source alternative to LangChain
Figma-like interface for building AI agents

name: agents-cli
description: Google's open-source CLI tool designed specifically for AI coding agents. Takes an AI agent from demo to production with scaffolding, evaluations, and deployment. Built to be used by AI agents like Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor. Bridges the gap between notebook prototypes and production-ready deployments.
community_quotes: From notebook demo agent to real world production agent
Ships enterprise agents with Google's tooling
Not for human use - designed for agents

name: Aura: Agents + Git + Intent
description: Open-source Git-native IDE/workspace for controlling AI coding agents with built-in loops. Unlike traditional chat-based coding assistants, Aura provides a desktop application where you can run agents, manage tasks, review AI-written code, and maintain control over your Git workflow. Local-first AI coding workspace that turns prompts into reviewed, validated code changes.
community_quotes: Not another chat box for coding
Git-native IDE approach to working with AI coding agents
Turns prompts into reviewed, validated code changes
The Git-Native Intelligence Layer for AI Coding Agents

name: TryCase
description: Disposable test environments for AI coding agents. Provides AI coding agents with isolated Linux environments to run applications, test changes end-to-end, capture screenshots and recordings, and return verified code. Addresses the challenge of flaky test environments that AI agents face.
community_quotes: The need for disposable, isolated environments aligns with challenges AI coding agents face
Sandboxed testing environments for AI code review automation

name: CodeMote
description: iOS app that lets you drive Claude Code, Codex, or any CLI agent from your iPhone. Pairs iPhone with your machine or VPS to provide real-time sessions with live terminal on lock screen, push notifications when agent needs approval, and remote control for long-running AI coding sessions.
community_quotes: Uses your existing Claude Code/Codex instance - no subscription hacks or ban risks
Mobile-friendly interface for interacting with AI coding agents
Particularly useful for approving migrations and multi-file refactor planning

name: Edgee Claude Code Compressor V2
description: Token compression gateway for Claude Code that compresses tokens before they reach Anthropic or OpenAI, claiming up to 50% cost reduction. Makes coding agents cheaper and faster by eliminating redundant tokens and optimizing context management.
community_quotes: Claims up to 50% lower costs through token compression
Makes coding agents cheaper, faster, unstoppable
Gateway for your coding agents
